cohort: The study cohort consisted of pregnant women in Bangladesh, drawing data from the nationally representative 2022 Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey.
finding: Only 41% of pregnant women achieved the recommended >= 4 ANC visits, and determinants such as education, wealth, prior caesarean delivery, birth order, and rural residence significantly influenced ANC utilization, with varying impacts across different regions of Bangladesh.
mod_finding: A prior caesarean delivery was found to significantly increase antenatal care use.
